risks: Concurrent root-owned wave0 edits can stale all line/hash evidence; input_revision is dispatch metadata, not a verified clean source revision.
Common calls contracts/commands/repository are repeated in WP-31/32/33/35; unrestricted package ownership would cause conflicting writers or replacement stores.

Two proposed WP-34 migration names and shared media_job table can collide with predecessor schema. transcript_id and stream namespace must be agreed before imposing uniqueness; never silently omit raw evidence.

Legacy native read handlers ignore transport ctx and mutation handlers accept actor/grant arguments. Extending those paths without authority cutover could violate negative-control acceptance even if local demos work.
Rox2CanonicalResult legacy triad and normative status/receiptId envelope do not match; DTO/schema compile gate needs explicit accepted mapping, not type aliasing by name.

Local Whisper positional IDs and lack of diarization can misattribute/rebind citations across inputs. Preserve per-input raw identity, never infer participants from text or fabricate speaker confidence.

Summary generation currently clips the final 30000 transcript characters and accepts arbitrary summary text without citations. Source coverage and every quoted span must be explicit and validated, not assumed hallucination-free.

Delayed summary results currently attach to a freshly read meeting without transcript revision check; correction/retranscription race can make stale results look current or leak changed guest mapping.
Existing applyMeetingSummary assigns summary into transcript; using it for archive integration would destroy the distinction between raw evidence and derived text.

Exactly-once logical jobs/events/notifications do not prove exactly-once external provider execution. Ambiguous provider outcome requires reconciliation before retry; do not claim queued or unknown is verified.

Recording, transcript and summary authorization/readiness are distinct. Empty/failed STT must not hide metadata or stop permitted finalized playback; room guest membership must not grant audio/transcript/guest-name access.

WP-35 preserves an actual local capture/import/Whisper/playback path and overlaps these files without being a direct WP-34 edge. Shared cutover must coordinate adapters and retain no-upload standalone behavior without promising an offline summary model.
Mentions/notifications/activity/agent/API/routing are mandatory completeness items but their concrete common integration interfaces were not supplied; no N/A or deferred-complete shortcut is valid.
ASR/provider/license/accuracy/diarization and sandbox runtime proofs remain prerequisites. Source inspection and fixture assertions cannot establish real provider or changed UI acceptance.
